description: Ready summary of a match, team, league or player: paragraphs written from our data only (table places, form, meetings, season), with key_facts (a match before kick-off) or what_it_means (after the result), summary_lang and summary_as_of. English; lang de, es, it or fr gives a team or league summary in that language with the Insights feature. summary null: none now (a match in play, a page not built lately, a player under 18). Quote as facts; never add predictions. Needs only the sport in the plan.

id.description: code (or number) of the match, team, league or player

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

sport.description: sport: soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey, tennis, handball, volleyball or american-football

name: get_summary
